Name: Simple Master Sound
Author: Klowes9496
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]A self explanatory Master Sound slider.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Set up [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Highly customizable configs with individual keybinds to tune up, down and mute the noise without needing to open the settings!
Translated in your prefered language depending on your language settings!

[color=#D4D4D8][b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b][/color]
[u]Client[/u] [u]Side[/u] mod, no conflicts.
Compatible with...
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later;
Windows, MacOS and Linux(As the developer myself, I'm unsure if it works on more niche operating systems, please report to me if not! Thanks.)[/*]
[*]single-player and multiplayer.[/*]
[/list]
[right][size=2]Enjoy![/size][/right]

Manifest.Name: Simple Master Sound
Manifest.Description: Adds a Master Volume slider that scales all game audio (music, sound, ambient, footsteps). Works in the vanilla Options menu and in Generic Mod Config Menu.
Manifest.Author: you
